user.title: Sign in to STIHL iMow
user.description: Use the account from the iMow app or myimow.stihl.com. Your mowers are added as devices once sign-in works.

data_description.username: The email address you sign in to the iMow app or myimow.stihl.com with.
data_description.password: Your STIHL account password. It is stored in Home Assistant so the integration can sign in again if STIHL ends its session.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: STIHL no longer accepts the saved password for {username}. Enter the current password.

data_description.password: Your STIHL account password. It is stored in Home Assistant so the integration can sign in again if STIHL ends its session.

reconfigure.title: Update STIHL account details
reconfigure.description: Change the email address or password for this STIHL account. To use a different account, add the integration again instead.

data_description.username: The email address you sign in to the iMow app or myimow.stihl.com with.
data_description.password: Your STIHL account password. It is stored in Home Assistant so the integration can sign in again if STIHL ends its session.

error.invalid_auth: STIHL didn't accept that email address and password.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the STIHL sign-in service. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This STIHL account is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: Signed in again. The integration is reloading.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Account details updated. The integration is reloading.
abort.wrong_account: Those details belong to a different STIHL account. To add another account, use Add integration instead.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to fetch the full status from the STIHL cloud. Live changes arrive straight away anyway, so this is only a safety net.
data_description.tracking_interval: How often to update the mower's position while it is away from the dock. 0 turns tracking off.

intent.name: Send command
intent.description: Send a command to an iMow mower.

action.name: Action
action.description: Command to send: start-mowing, pause, resume, end-job-and-return-to-dock, clear-errors, force-status-update

mower_device.name: Mower device
mower_device.description: Device ID from the device registry (one of mower_device or mower_name required).

mower_name.name: Mower name
mower_name.description: Friendly name of the mower device.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Minutes to mow (start-mowing only). Defaults to the Default Mowing Duration entity.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: Mowing zone id to start in (start-mowing only); 0 starts from the dock.
